## 9-Point Quality Checklist
Please ensure that the following checks are fulfilled before submitting:

- [ ] **1. Task Name**: Clearly stated in the PR title and description.
- [ ] **2. Status**: Verified self-contained and working (`SUCCESS`).
- [ ] **3. Completed Actions**: All promised functionality implemented without placeholders.
- [ ] **4. Modified Files**: Scoped strictly to relevant files (no accidental lockfile churn or temp files).
- [ ] **5. Executed Verifications**: Ran `npm test` and `npm run doctor`.
- [ ] **6. Verification Results**: All automated tests pass with 100% exit code 0.
- [ ] **7. Identified Risks**: No secret tokens leaked, no unhandled async race conditions.
- [ ] **8. Unfinished Items**: Any follow-up items explicitly noted in issues.
- [ ] **9. Recommended Next Steps**: Handoff or operational verification notes provided.
